import pytest

from src.api.routes.items import (
    favorite_item,
    get_item,
    list_favorite_items,
    list_items,
    unfavorite_item,
)
from src.api.routes.users import get_user


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _reset_favorites():
    for user_id in (1, 2):
        user = get_user(user_id)
        if user is not None:
            user.favorite_item_ids.clear()
    yield


def test_list_items_omits_archived_items_by_default():
    items = list_items()
    assert all(not item["archived"] for item in items)


def test_get_item_returns_matching_item():
    assert get_item(1)["name"] == "Notebook"


def test_favorite_item_adds_to_favorites():
    result = favorite_item(user_id=1, item_id=1)
    assert result["ok"] is True
    favorites = list_favorite_items(user_id=1)
    assert [f["id"] for f in favorites] == [1]


def test_favorite_non_owned_item_fails():
    result = favorite_item(user_id=1, item_id=3)
    assert result["ok"] is False
    assert list_favorite_items(user_id=1) == []


def test_favorite_item_is_idempotent():
    favorite_item(user_id=1, item_id=1)
    favorite_item(user_id=1, item_id=1)
    favorites = list_favorite_items(user_id=1)
    assert [f["id"] for f in favorites] == [1]


def test_unfavorite_item_removes_from_favorites():
    favorite_item(user_id=1, item_id=1)
    result = unfavorite_item(user_id=1, item_id=1)
    assert result["ok"] is True
    assert list_favorite_items(user_id=1) == []


def test_unfavorite_item_is_idempotent_when_not_favorited():
    result = unfavorite_item(user_id=1, item_id=1)
    assert result["ok"] is True
    assert list_favorite_items(user_id=1) == []


def test_list_favorite_items_returns_only_users_favorites():
    favorite_item(user_id=1, item_id=2)
    favorite_item(user_id=2, item_id=3)
    user1_favs = list_favorite_items(user_id=1)
    assert [f["id"] for f in user1_favs] == [2]
